list.heading: Accounts
list.subtitle: Hosting accounts on this server.
list.emptyDescription: Create the first hosting account to get started.
list.noMatchesDescription: Try a different name or domain, or clear the filter to see every account.

form.heading: New account
form.subtitle: The panel checks these values before sending them, and the server checks them again.

errors.nameInvalid: Name must be a lowercase, Linux-username-safe identifier (letters, digits, underscore, starting with a letter, 3-30 characters).
errors.primaryDomainInvalid: Primary domain must be a valid domain name.
errors.ownerEmailInvalid: Owner email must be a valid email address.

detail.heading: Account
detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted since this link was made.
detail.confirmSuspend: Suspend this account? Its sites stop serving and its user can no longer sign in. A file transfer running now is cut off, and the partial file it wrote stays in the account.
detail.invitationResent: A new invitation has been sent. The panel cannot confirm it was delivered — its mail queue does not retry.
detail.suspendedNotice: This account is suspended. Its sites are not serving and its user cannot sign in.

delete.title: Delete {account}
delete.refusedNote: Nothing was deleted. The account is exactly as it was, and it can be deleted again once whatever refused has been dealt with.
delete.removedUser: The system user and its login.
delete.removedHome: The home directory and every file in it.
delete.removedSites: Every site this account hosts, and its web-server configuration.
delete.removedCertificates: The certificates of those sites, and their private keys on this server.
delete.removedDatabases: Every database this account owns, and its SFTP and FTPS logins.
delete.backupFirst: A final copy of the account is taken first, before anything is removed.
delete.backupRefuses: If that copy cannot be made, the deletion is refused and the account is left exactly as it is.
delete.backupOutlives: The copy stays on this server after the account is gone, listed under the name the account had.
delete.backupNoModule: This panel has no backups module, so no final copy is taken. Once this account is gone, nothing here holds what it had.
delete.pointOfNoReturn: After the copy is taken, nothing here can bring the account back.
delete.confirmLabel: Type the account name to confirm
